header_sentences: Footnote:  In the excerpts that relate to this article, sometimes the the translated text salvation is based on the Latin word salvatio, instead of salus. In those places, we have inserted in the text for clarity.

contexts.text: When a man becomes (profane) there is not any hope of salvation (there). Explained.
So there would not be any hope of salvation for them in the other life.
The things here said about the internal man... are not necessary to salvation.
The reward of His victories was the salvation of the universal human race. AC 1812. AC 1813. AC 1820:5.
They compel themselves... for the sake of the salvation (or health) of their souls after death; within which there is... a regard for the... Lord.
The essentials of faith, being necessary to salvation, are stated in the letter...

That all regeneration... consequently salvation, is from the Lord alone, is known... but is believed by few. Explained... Only so far as a man is in charity... can he be in this principal thing of faith; that all salvation is from the Lord.
That from the Lord's Divine Human is all salvation for those who are in good. Signified, Explained. AC 2670. AC 2714:end. AC 2854.
There is salvation for the spiritual also, if they are in good. Illustrated.
My salvation unto the extremity of the earth (). Explained.
That the Lord is salvation to the human race...
The generals of that Thing which conduce to the salvation of man.

If one who leads a life of good... suffers himself to be persuaded that a life of good contributes nothing to salvation... and that a saving means has been provided, which is called faith, and thus that he can be saved through faith without a life of good... he is called torn.

Think that all outside the Church are damned, and this from the received canon, that outside the Lord there is no salvation, which is true. But in the other life good gentiles easily acknowledge the Lord; whereas (such Christians) when left to themselves... do not even adore Him; so that these are the ones who are outside the Lord, who have not salvation.
From (doctrinals), and not from (the goods of charity), they think much about eternal salvation.
By peace, they understood... life in the Lord's Kingdom, or salvation; in the external sense, salvation in the world, or health. AC 4712.

He confirms himself... until he believes that works of charity are not necessary to salvation; and (then) that there has been provided... a means of salvation called faith; and, at last, this: that he will be saved, if, from confidence (he says a certain thing at the hour of death).
I will take the cup of salvation () = the appropriation of the goods of faith.

Who believes that the fruits (of faith) contribute anything to salvation, when it is believed that man is saved through faith in the last hour of his life, however he has previously lived; and (said) that faith alone saves without good works, or that works... contribute nothing to salvation?
(This is) contrary to the acknowledgement that all salvation is from mercy. Explained.
I wait for Thy salvation Jehovah () = unless the Lord brings aid. Explained.
Gad = those who place in works alone everything of salvation, like the Pharisee... That which saves them, is the intention to do what is good, and something of innocence in their ignorance.
The Divine Providence has for its end the eternal salvation of man, not his being well off (here).
See Salvation.
For those in evils never acknowledge that charity and its works contribute to salvation; for they cannot acknowledge what is contrary to their own life.
With the evil, there is no internal fear, namely, for salvation...
Anxieties (in spiritual temptations) are... on account of the loss of faith and charity, and consequently of salvation. AC 8567.
Stand still, and see the salvation of Jehovah () = salvation by the Lord alone, and not at all by themselves. Explained.
He has become my salvation () = that thence is salvation.
Providence continually leads to salvation, through various states...
He who does not know that all good is front the Lord, cannot think that... his salvation is from Him...
It is impossible to compel man to salvation; (otherwise) all men in the world would be saved. Explained.

Mine own arm brought salvation unto Me () = ... that the Lord did these things from His Own power. That thence is salvation, is described by (His being) great to save... and that He became their Saviour. AC 9715:4. AC 10828.
That salvation went forth from the Divine in ultimates. Signified.
Therefore he who, within the Church, does not acknowledge the Lord, has no conjunction with the Divine... and when there is no conjunction with the Divine, there is no salvation.
That the salvation of the human race is from (the union of the Divine Itself in the Lord's Human)... Illustrated.

The universal of all things (of the Church) is that the Lord united His Human to the Divine Itself, and that thence man has peace and salvation; and it is also a universal, that man must be conjoined with the Lord in order that he may have peace and salvation.
(Thus) the Divine Providence is in each and all things which conduce to the salvation of the human race.
(Such priests) prefer honour and gain to the salvation of souls; but those who give the honour to the Lord... prefer the salvation of souls to honour and gain.

Unless the Lord had... become a Man, and in that way delivered from Hell all who believe in and love Him, no mortal could have been saved. Thus is it understood, that without the Lord there is no salvation.
It is known from the Word that the Lord wills the salvation of all, and the damnation of no one.

Nothing of the Lord can be imputed to man, but salvation can be ascribed by the Lord after the man has performed repentance... Then is salvation ascribed to him in this way: that the man is saved, not from his own merit, or justice, but from the Lord, who... alone fights for man, and conquers the Hells for him.
All things which pertain to man's life, thus to his salvation, are naked (in the letter of the Word).
The good of the priesthood is to look out for the salvation of souls... (Compare DLife 72.)
They can blaze with zeal for the salvation of souls, yet from infernal fire.
It is provided... that in every religion there are the two essentials of salvation, which are to acknowledge God, and not to do evil because it is against God...
Salvation to our God... () = that the Lord is salvation itself, and that all salvation is from Him; thus that He is the Saviour.
Because on the Knowledge and acknowledgement of God depends the salvation of everyone.
Now is come salvation and power () = that now they are saved by the Divine power of the Lord. AE 745.
(The notion that good is to be done, but not for the sake of salvation, refuted.)

Salvation and glory and honour and power to the Lord our God () = that now there is salvation from the Lord, because now there is reception of the Divine truth and Divine good from His Divine power. Salvation to the Lord our God = the acknowledgement and confession that salvation is from the Lord. (Compare AE 1198.)
These highest ones (in Heaven) are chosen from those whose heart is in the public welfare.

The Lord is continually operating these salvations (reformation, regeneration, etc.) with every man; for they are steps to Heaven; for the Lord wills the salvation of all; and therefore the salvation of all is His end; and he who wills an end, wills the means. His advent, redemption, and passion... were for the sake of the salvation of men (; ); and, as the salvation of men was, and to eternity is, His end, it follows that the above-mentioned operations are the mediate ends, and Salvation the intimate end. TCR 152.

Because He is salvation and eternal life; salvation, because He is the Saviour, which Jesus means... As He is salvation and eternal life... He is all that by which salvation and eternal life are obtained; consequently, is the all of reformation, etc., and, at last, is Salvation.
In proportion as this spirituality is augmented, this delight becomes bliss; and this is his salvation, which is called eternal life.
That conjunction with the Lord is [that] through which man has salvation and eternal life. General article. TCR 726. Explained.
Does not know what saving good is. Explained.
That (the modern) imputation is twofold: one, of the merit of Christ; and the other, of salvation thence. Explained.
From the transcription of the imputation of the former Church into that of the New one... would arise tragic things, which would stand in the way of the man's salvation.
That (the Lord) is also salvation, is because this and eternal life are one. His name Jesus also means salvation... and from this He is called the Saviour.
Salvation depends upon conjunction with God.
Good and saving counsels...
Where nothing exists which does not have something of health from the general (body)...
That knowledges contribute nothing to salvation...
Good and salutary foods...
(Animals eat foods) which are wholesome lo them.
(The Moravians) think much about their salvation, and that they are saved, and not others; hence they have (this interior friendship).
This first of the Church is to acknowledge... that without the Lord there is no salvation.
Hearing and help... through the Divine truth, is signified by... Answer me in the Truth of Thy salvation ().
As the Lord then come into the world would save all who receive Him, (Simeon) called the Lord the salvation which his eyes saw, which He prepares for all people ().
The fountain of salvation (or of Israel) () = spiritual good, because through this is salvation.
Name, is said of truths; and salvation () of good.
Salvation () = eternal life.
To make to hear salvation () = conjunction with Him through truths, and through a life according to them; for through this is salvation.

My justice is near. My salvation is gone forth () = the Judgment, when those are saved who are in the good of love, and who are in truths thence; justice is said of the Salvation of those who are in good... and salvation, of the Salvation of those who are in truths.
Exalted be the God of my salvation () = that He is to be worshipped through truths from good, whence is salvation.
The salvations of my faces () = all things which are within; thus which are of the mind and the affections, consequently which are of love and faith, which, because they save, are called salvations.
That they may be saved, is signified by, Go for salvation to us ().
From the tribes of Issachar were sealed 12 thousand = faith and salvation. Explained.
Salvation to our God... () = that eternal life is from the Lord alone... salvation = eternal life; for by eternal life is meant eternal salvation.

Salvation being [ascribed] to Him = that salvation is from Him, because He is salvation: for everything of salvation and eternal life is from Him, and is of Him with man and Angel. Explained, Illustrated.
The Lord is here called salvation, from Salvation, and from the fact that He is salvation with man: for in proportion as He is with man, man has salvation. Illustrated.
Therefore He was called Jesus, which means salvation.
(It is a mistake) that man can do nothing towards his salvation. Explained.
(Thus) the health of the body depends upon the state of the extremes.
We await... salvation far from us () = the hope... of Salvation, but in vain.
Deliverance from evils by the Lord, and Salvation, is meant by, Who shall give out of Zion the salvation of Israel? ().
That the Lord provides for every nation a universal means of salvation. Explained.
Trinity. 9. 6. (It is found) that there is nothing of salvation, except with those who have done goods from religion; because these are receptible of faith in the Lord God the Saviour (there).
Trinity. 9. 11. That the Divine Trinity is in the Lord God the Saviour, and consequently (He) alone is to be approached, for there to be salvation, or eternal life. Chapter.
When the salvation of souls affects (a priest).
